what_happened: The task's creation-time file_scope declares 5 paths but a mechanical grep of the source store found ~50 files referencing the surface, including four live code paths the description does not enumerate: the engine-written-state staging allowlist in scripts/lib/engine-written-state-paths-lib.sh, measure-eager-context.sh's VOLATILE_PATHS deny-list, hooks/events-log-artifact.sh's case branch, and orchestrator-postflight.sh's error_ref cross-link. The plan widens to 8 phases accordingly; file_scope will be widened by plan-file-scope-harvest.sh rather than by the creation-time declaration.

validate-artifact.sh's Tier Justification under-verification check caught three phases whose hand-picked run-all.sh --only lists were narrower than what the repository's own suite_selection_select resolves for the same touched paths. The warning named the exact missing suites, turning a guess into a mechanical correction: two phases now compose suite_selection_select into --only, and one was honestly raised to full because it edits scripts/lib/common.sh, a surface every suite sources.

Phase 2's own verification grep (errors-append|errors-format|errors-schema over manifest.json/index-entries.json) caught an unlisted match: the standards/error-recovery-strategies.md index entry's summary and keywords named errors-append.sh even though that path was not in Phase 2's enumerated edit list. Corrected it in Phase 2 (retargeted to issue-record.sh wording) to satisfy the phase's own stated check and pre-empt Phase 5's planned content retarget of the same underlying file.

While running the Phase 4 selector suite test-git-commit-scoped.sh, observed a FOREIGN uncommitted modification to agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/git-commit-scoped.sh (present at this dispatch's start, not made by this dispatch -- confirmed via git diff, which shows an in-flight V12 addition: 'every positive pathspec deliberately gitignored' now returns exit 1 instead of exit 2). This causes test-git-commit-scoped.sh's pre-existing U5 case to fail (expected rc=2, got rc=1) -- unrelated to this task's own Z16/case-13 edits, which both pass (75 passed, 1 failed, the 1 being U5). Not touched; this is another task's in-flight work on a shared file named in this task's own Territory Note.

Phase 4's own stated verification criterion ('grep -rn specs/errors.json agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/ agent-system/extensions/core/hooks/ returns nothing') is in tension with Phase 4's own task list, which explicitly requires rewriting test cases (test-engine-written-state-paths-lib.sh case c, test-git-commit-scoped.sh Z16, test-git-commit-phase.sh case 13) to assert specs/errors.json's ABSENCE from the widened set -- those inverted assertions necessarily still reference the literal string 'specs/errors.json' as the fixture path being tested for exclusion. Interpreted the verification criterion by its evident intent (no PRODUCTION code path still treats specs/errors.json as live/admitted) rather than literally: confirmed zero matches in the five non-test production files this phase edits (engine-written-state-paths-lib.sh, measure-eager-context.sh, events-log-artifact.sh, orchestrator-postflight.sh, events-append.sh); the only remaining matches are the three test files' deliberate inverted-assertion fixtures and one orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh comment explicitly deferred to Phase 7's own task list.
